evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies `AllocateFileRange` in src/util/fs_helpers.cpp to fix fallback zero-fill truncation.
rationale: Fixes a data-overwriting bug in `AllocateFileRange` when preallocating within existing file boundaries on platforms lacking native `posix_fallocate`. As noted in the description, the zero-fill fallback and Windows implementation previously zeroed out or truncated existing file contents.
